name: Thai omelet with crab
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai (2 eggs, 1 tsp fish sauce, 1/4 cup oil to deep fry for 2) and Eating Thai Food (2 eggs, a heaping tablespoon of minced pork, a splash of soy sauce, oil). A Thai omelet takes up oil: 25 g stays in it of the 1/4 cup in the pan. Two large eggs are 100 g. Crab is 40 g of cooked meat.
